question_en: Which RAN5 specs do recent CRs modify? (change-to-spec mapping)
original_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN cr.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 5
reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN cr.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 5
